import importlib; import sys; 
if 'semver' in sys.modules:
    del sys.modules['semver']

import semver
content = open("semver.py").read(); lines = content.split("\n")

main_start = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if "def main" in line:
        main_start = i
        break

# Print from main to next function
result = []
i = main_start + 1
while i < len(lines) and not (lines[i].startswith("def ") and not lines[i].strip().startswith("#")):
    result.append(f"{i+1}: {lines[i]}")
    i += 1
"\n".join(result)
